title: M PAT (Provable Acceptance Test)
description: Schema for story-level and sub-task-level PAT.yaml files. Story PATs define the full acceptance contract for a user story. Sub-task PATs scope acceptance criteria to what is verifiable in isolation for a single component.

oneOf.description: Story-level PAT — lives in root repo at pats/<story-id>.pat.yaml
Sub-task PAT — lives in managed repo at pats/<sub-task-id>.pat.yaml

story.description: Story identifier (e.g. TODOM-001, PROJ-042). Present on story-level PATs only.

sub-task.description: Sub-task identifier (e.g. TODOM-001c). Story ID + alphabetic suffix. Present on sub-task PATs only.

parent-story.description: Parent story identifier. Required on sub-task PATs.

component.description: Component name from project.yaml (e.g. todo-m-mfe). Required on sub-task PATs.

acceptance.description: Ordered list of acceptance criteria. Order matters — later entries may depend on state created by earlier ones.

id.description: Unique within this PAT file. Format: AC-NNN for single criteria, AC-NNNx (a,b,c...) when one acceptance criterion yields multiple test scenarios.

when.description: Trigger condition in plain English. User-facing, topology-agnostic. No component names, API paths, or CSS selectors.

then.description: Expected outcome in plain English. Observable result from the user's perspective.

steps.description: Ordered test steps. Each step is an object with exactly one verb key. The active test.cat.* provider compiles each verb to a runner-native command — for cypress, browser steps emit cy commands and HTTP steps emit cy.request().

replaces.description: AC this supersedes, from a previous story. Format: <story-id>/AC-<id>. Compiler must find and update the old compiled test.

removes.description: AC this deletes, from a previous story. Format: <story-id>/AC-<id>. Compiler must find and delete the old compiled test.

step.description: A single test step. Exactly one verb key per step object.

step-navigate.description: Navigate to a URL path. Compiles to cy.visit(path).

step-click.description: Click an element by data-testid selector. Format: [data-testid='<id>']. Author in yaml as a double-quoted scalar: "[data-testid='<id>']". Compiles to cy.get(selector).click().

step-type.description: Type text into an element. Format: [data-testid='<id>'] value '<text>'. Author in yaml as a double-quoted scalar so the inner single quotes parse cleanly. Text may not contain a single quote. Compiles to cy.get(selector).type(text).

step-assert.description: Assert a condition on an element. Formats: [selector] is visible | [selector] is disabled | [selector] contains '<value>' | [selector] count > N. Author in yaml as a double-quoted scalar. Inner string values use single quotes and may not contain a single quote.

step-wait.description: Wait for a condition on an element. Same formats as assert but waits with retry. Subset of predicates: is visible | contains '<value>'. Compiles to cy.get(selector).should(...).

step-render.description: Render a component with a mock setup. Sub-task PATs only (not browser-level). Not compiled to Cypress — used for component-level testing.
examples: Todo component with empty mock API

step-http.description: HTTP request. Format: <METHOD> <url>[ body '<json>']. URL may be relative (resolved against the runner's baseUrl) or absolute. Body, when present, must be a valid JSON value embedded as a single-quoted scalar — JSON keys and string values use double quotes, so the JSON itself contains no single quotes (use \u0027 if an apostrophe is genuinely needed). Compiles to cy.request(...).as('lastResponse').

step-expect-status.description: Assert the HTTP status code of the most recent http step. Compiles to cy.get('@lastResponse').its('status').should('equal', N).

step-expect-body-contains.description: Literal substring match against the response body of the most recent http step. Not a JSON path — JSON-shape bodies are stringified and matched as text, so authors include the JSON punctuation they expect (e.g. "\"count\":0"). Author in yaml as a double-quoted scalar; the value may not contain a single quote.

step-expect-unreachable.description: Assert the most recent http step did NOT receive a 1xx-4xx response. Passes if the request failed at the network layer (DNS failure, connection refused, timeout) OR returned a 5xx. Fails if the request returned 1xx/2xx/3xx/4xx — those would mean a service answered, which contradicts 'the endpoint is gone'. Use exclusively in REMOVE story PATs to assert the negative-existence of a previously-existing endpoint. Compiles atomically with the preceding http step (cy.request throws on network errors before any chained .then runs, so the http: + expect-unreachable pair is rewritten as a single fetch+catch block rather than chaining off @lastResponse).
